subject: Synergo renewal & new RAG pilot — SLO validation and kickoff plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom@synergo.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.k@synergo.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Synergo renewal & new RAG pilot — SLO validation and kickoff plan

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps. I kept this intentionally short.

What we heard (pain points)
- Production RAG latency spikes when vector store returns long contexts; user-facing 95th percentile latency ~450–600ms today.
- Cost pressure as throughput scales during peak queries (hourly burst to ~18k tokens/min).
- Inconsistent chunking + KV cache misses cause repeat work per request.

Goals you described
- Reduce 95th pctl latency to <150ms for the chat flow used by customer support in Q4.
- Keep per-1k-token cost flat or improve vs current baseline (target: <=$0.45/1k tokens).
- Run a controlled Dedicated pilot for priority workstreams (support RAG + streaming inference) with a clear upgrade path to reserved capacity for Q1.

Key signals we reviewed
- Last 30d usage: steady 3M tokens/mo, peaks to ~13M tokens in heavy weeks (see attached synergo-usage-summary.csv).
- Primary model: open Llama2-13B quantized; heavy short-context chat + occasional multi-page RAG passes.

Proposed pilot scope (what we recommend)
1) 4-week Dedicated pilot (staged):
   - Week 1: baseline perf & KV cache tuning on existing workload (no model changes).
   - Week 2–3: quantization + kernel optimizations, batching policy tweaks; validate 95p latency.
   - Week 4: reliability soak + SLA/rollback plan.
2) Success metrics: 95p latency <150ms for the chat endpoint, token cost <= $0.45/1k (or clear path to that with batching).
3) Fallbacks: automatic routing to lower-cost model for non-critical traffic; feature flag for burst scaling.

Attachments: Redwood proposal v1 + synergo usage CSV.

Ask / next steps (owners)
- Tom / Priya: confirm pilot scope and SLO above or propose edits by EoD Friday.
- Synergo: provide an exported sample of 3 representative conversation traces (anonymized) by next Tue — this will speed tuning.
- Redwood (Ben / Jordan / me): will create a one-page SOW stub and an estimated cost model by Thu.

If that aligns, I’ll send the SOW stub and proposed kickoff dates. Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Synergo renewal & new RAG pilot — SLO validation and kickoff plan

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- The 95th pctl numbers I quoted were for the agent-facing endpoint; for the customer chat widget it’s closer to ~320ms on 95p (still above target). We should tune the widget path first.
- The peaks are slightly higher during Monday morning syncs — closer to 20k tokens/min but those are ~10% of traffic.

We’re aligned on the pilot shape. One ask: can we include a short Dedicated + Private network test (VPC peering) in Week 3? Security needs to validate network hops before we commit to reserved capacity. If possible, mark that as optional in the SOW.

Also, cost target: $0.45/1k tokens is reasonable as a pilot goal, but we’d like a clear path to $0.35/1k under committed Reserved capacity.

I’ll pull the three anonymized traces and drop them to the drive link you listed by Monday EoD.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Ellis | Head of Platform Engineering
Synergo.ai

Forwarding Tom’s clarifications. I’ll take point on the cost model and reserve-case pricing. Proposed immediate internal plan:
- I’ll draft two pricing scenarios by Thu: (A) 4-week pilot on Dedicated with temporary burst capacity; (B) 90-day committed Reserved capacity with stepped discounts (goal: reach $0.35/1k for full commit).
- Jordan, can you confirm engineering availability for Week 2 kernel/quantization changes? We should lock a two-day dev window.
- Marissa, I’ll also prepare a short security checklist so the VPC test in Week 3 is scoped (what telemetry/logs they’ll need to see).

I’ll sync with Product to get a rough SLA addendum we can include in the SOW stub.

Thanks Tom — this all works. Quick update and final asks so we can lock the kickoff: 

Confirmed changes from today
- Pilot stays 4 weeks, with optional VPC peering + private-network verification added to Week 3 (security checklist attached).
- Pilot success metric: 95p latency <150ms for the chat widget endpoint; pilot pricing target $0.45/1k tokens with a committed Reserved path projection to $0.35/1k.

Draft timeline (proposed)
- Fri, Aug 6: Signed SOW stub + pilot acceptance (PM approval).
- Mon, Aug 9: Engineering kickoff & data handoff (samples uploaded to Drive).
- Mon, Aug 9–Fri, Aug 13: Baseline measurements & KV cache tuning.
- Mon, Aug 16–Fri, Aug 27: Optimizations (quantization, batching, kernel choices).
- Mon, Aug 30: Reliability soak, security test (VPC peering), final validation.

Deliverables we’re attaching now: SOW stub (synergo-sow-stub.docx) and a security checklist. Please:
- Tom / Priya: reply-all with approval ("SOW OK") or edits by EoD Fri Aug 6.
- Synergo: upload the three anonymized trace files to the Drive link by Mon Aug 9.

If we get approval, Ben / Jordan / I will schedule the kickoff and share a short runbook for the first-week measurements.

Best regards,
Marissa
